facts.fact: Dagon 在 Lupercalia 之战后被 Temidorus 救下送医，出院回公寓发现 satyr 占了他的沙发
facts.anchor: He’s just got out of hospital.

facts.fact: 战后 Michele 与 Giada 给 Pan 立规矩：收敛暴力，他们会盯着他；因为 Hook 的下场，Pan 暂时会听
facts.anchor: Next my grandkids and that gorgeous Giada took him to one side and gave him a good talking to.

facts.fact: Dal Mare 已死，身上背着一堆调查，还包括 Pineto Park 的清算旧账
facts.anchor: There’s a whole load of investigations into him.

facts.fact: Angela、Giada 与 Tinker Bell 组成巡演秀，明天在柏林首演，内容是魔术加 burlesque
facts.anchor: She’s on tour with Giada and Tinker Bell.

facts.fact: Giovanni 处理家产并起诉 Dal Mare 名下公司诽谤，动机是不让自己闲下来想 Luisa
facts.anchor: They will be soon, but I don’t think that’s what’s motivating Giovanni.

facts.fact: Giovanni 在清理家里的公寓与存款，准备与 Dal Mare 的公司打官司求和
facts.anchor: He’s sorting out the family assets.

facts.fact: Temidorus 把 Dagon 的卧室让给一位春绿色头发的树精，自称是 Silenus 介绍的
facts.anchor: Between the sheets was a naked dryad

facts.fact: 全书最后一句：Temidorus 已邀请一帮朋友今晚来 Dagon 家，日常的混乱继续
facts.anchor: I invited a few friends over tonight.
